note: Insensible: aware, not indifferent. Claggart is vain of his looks.
Billy’s warm nature is pictured as a fire lighting his face from within.
Inkling: a hint. Claggart gave away his reason in a joke.
Irreconcilable: impossible to bring into agreement.

anchor: many an arraigned mortal has in hopes of mitigated penalty
note: Mitigated: made less severe. Arraigned: charged in court.

anchor: more shameful than even felonious crime
note: Felonious: criminal. A felony is a serious crime.

anchor: the better sort are inclined to incredulity when it is in earnest imputed
note: Imputed: charged to a person as a fault.

anchor: its lodgement is in the heart not the brain
note: Lodgement: the place where something settles.

anchor: apprehensive jealousy that marred Saul’s visage perturbedly brooding on the comely young David
note: King Saul grew jealous of David because the women sang that Saul had slain thousands but David ten thousands.
source: The Bible (King James Version), 1 Samuel 18:7, https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/10

note: Askance: with a sideways look of suspicion or envy.

anchor: the reactionary bite of that serpent
note: Reactionary: reacting back. The serpent is evil, which Billy has never felt.
Ineffability: the quality of being too great to put into words.
Suppled: made flexible and easy in movement.
Disdain: scornful contempt, looking down on something.

anchor: in an aesthetic way he saw the charm of it
note: Aesthetic: concerned with beauty and its appeal to the senses.

anchor: fain would have shared it, but he despaired of it
note: Fain: gladly. Claggart would gladly share Billy’s innocence but knows he cannot.

anchor: With no power to annul the elemental evil in him
note: Annul: to cancel, put an end to. Elemental: basic and primal.

anchor: a nature like Claggart’s surcharged with energy
note: Surcharged: overloaded, filled beyond what it can easily hold.

anchor: like the scorpion for which the Creator alone is responsible
note: A scorpion cannot help stinging. Melville says Claggart acts from his nature.
